backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md core multi-window protocol plus Space frozen snapshots

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies; forward replacement profiles come from closed 2026 event-state ledger rows, so any helper remains default-off metadata and live Space slots stay zero.

attention_overlay_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least one attention-only event seed and at least one official non-attention event seed

government_contract_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with government_space_contract from an official non-attention source

multi_event_depth.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

single_event_defense_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with exactly one official non-attention seed, government_space_contract present, no customer_win, and defense_budget_theme

gate_questions.q1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: scale official Space signals where closed 10d same-theme replacement value is materially stronger than the accepted merely-positive exp-113 profile.
q2_prior_experiments: exp-20260513-113 accepted cash-positive plus same-theme-positive forward replacement risk at 1.05x.
exp-20260513-111 rejected source-diverse strong peer-excess retuning.
exp-20260513-037 rejected non-dilutive contract profile risk because the edge was single-window concentrated.
gate_questions.q3_single_causal_variable: Only the additional same-theme-strength risk scalar changes; accepted exp-113 forward scalar and all entries/exits/ranking/targets stay fixed.
gate_questions.q4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least two EV-improved windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown damage <= 0.5pp, survival >= 5%, >=50 aggregate trades, real adjusted signals, and target set narrower than exp-113.

hypothesis: On top of accepted exp-20260513-113, official Space signals whose closed 10d forward event-state profile has stronger same-theme replacement value may deserve incremental default-off risk. This tests the playbook's forward replacement-value direction without LLM soft-ranking, ticker expansion, or live Space slots.
known_risks: The Space sleeve remains default-off and historical Space snapshots are frozen research copies.
Forward replacement profiles are closed 2026 outcomes and should not be treated as proof for live routing.
The floor sweep is a same-sample profile-strength scout; promotion needs conservative sizing and parity tests if accepted.
next_evidence_needed: Promote only as shared default-off Space metadata/helper; keep live Space slots at zero until forward replacement evidence broadens.

locked_variables: all prior accepted Space risk helpers

single_causal_variable: extra risk scalar for the narrowed official Space closed-forward same-theme replacement-strength profile bucket
why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking remains label-thin; noisy ticker expansion and mature satcom breadth have failed; recent source-diversity peer magnitude retunes are exhausted. This tests forward replacement profile strength instead.
